description: Agent Governance: submit an agent operations setup: each agent with whether it runs in production, its named owner and owner type, who responds and who is paged when it errs, and its fallback for when it is wrong or down (manual process, previous version, kill switch or degraded mode) with who runs it and whether it has been exercised. The signed report names every production agent with no named person as owner, every error path with no responder or no one paged, and every agent with no fallback or an unowned or untested one. Escalation timing is wever_escalation-threshold-check, the incident plan document is wever_incident-plan-check and evidence after an incident is wever_incident-evidence-check. Verdict unowned_agents, response_gaps, ownership_unverified or owned_before_incident. POST /api/incident-ownership-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-governance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-governance/.

fallback.description: What runs when it is wrong or down.

owner.description: The named person who owns its outcomes.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

name: wever_incident-ownership-check
title: Incident ownership check
